## Behavior change

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes, or unavailable checks are explained.
- [ ] New behavior and relevant failure cases have meaningful tests.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match implemented behavior.
- [ ] Skill content and scripts have been reviewed; host compatibility claims have evidence.
- [ ] New or changed skills have an evaluation suite with static checks; any recorded results come from real runs.

## Risks or limitations

Describe material tradeoffs and anything still unverified.
